integrity: The aggregate reduction for total population and total noncompliance is obtained by exact cancellation of the six ODEs.
The 1/t coefficient follows from an exact integrating-factor solution; no finite experiment is used to establish the asymptotic theorem.
A bundled exact-rational verifier checks a concrete point on the critical surface and the invariant-slice formula, while the universal result is proved symbolically.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for autonomous constant controls with xi=0 and does not cover time-varying controls, stochastic forcing, spatial diffusion, or the doubly critical disease threshold R_D=1.

The general 1/t mechanism is familiar from critical SIS/logistic dynamics; the claimed contribution is the exact equality closure and full-state asymptotic profile for these specific recent six-compartment noncompliance models.
The 2022 SIAR predecessor was compared at the model-scope and abstract level; it has a different compartment structure and is not used as evidence for source-specific noncoverage.
title: Critical noncompliance threshold closes with a sharp \(1/t\) law
